{{Quote|Everything is advancing rapidly, but there are some that are resisting the energies released from the chambers. Tyla Grant, our Medical Doctor whom has also become sympathetic to the tombs wishes, has concocted a potion that will help persuade the remaining expedition members.|Page 6 of [[Lost Diary of Walter Emanus|Walter Emanus' lost journal]]|<ref name="SWG:WELJ" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Tyla Grant''' was a physician who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was part of the archeological expedition that accompanied [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Walter Emanus]] in the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Grant and most of the team eventually fall under the influence of the dark spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].<ref name="SWG:WELJ" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tyla Grant was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WELJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tyla Grant was mentioned in the [[W:c:swg:Walter Emanus' Lost Journal, Page 6|sixth page of Walter Emanus' journal]]. It was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:WELJ" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
